create_etcd_rdzv_handler: create an etcd rendezvous handler from RendezvousParameters with etcd endpoint, job id, and worker count configuration
create_etcd_client: create an etcd client from RendezvousParameters with hostname, port, protocol, and optional SSL certificate configuration
join_etcd_rendezvous: join an etcd-backed elastic rendezvous by comparing-and-swapping worker membership into the shared etcd state
confirm_etcd_membership: confirm worker membership in a frozen etcd rendezvous by registering ephemeral keep-alive keys and transitioning state to final
set_closed_etcd_rendezvous: mark an etcd rendezvous as closed so that no other workers attempt to join the current run_id
